response.justification: Bogdan has exceptional technical depth, open-source contributions, and diverse engineering experience, but lacks demonstrated leadership in architectural oversight, team management at executive level, and formal German proficiency (only 'Basic' listed), which are critical for this role.
strengths: Extensive open-source contributions with real-world impact (e.g., GISCollective)
Proven full-stack expertise across multiple languages and environments (DLang, Node.js, Linux)
Strong track record of mentoring and teaching via workshops and community initiatives
concerns: German language proficiency is only 'Basic' — fails minimum C1 requirement
No explicit evidence of leading teams, managing client projects, or defining enterprise architecture
Lacks documented experience in UML, requirements management, or IT security/compliance frameworks
